title: Guest entry
description: What the guest entry answers the customers' sign-in (ADR-0007, The guest entry, and its amendment of 2026-11-08): a new visitor's tokens with the welcome, or a refusal. A full day and the pause are answers, so they come as a 200, as the chat's refusals come in a 200 stream; a throttle or a fault comes as an error status with API Gateway's or Lambda's own body, never this contract.

entered.description: A new user in the customer and visitor groups, signed in through the customers' app client: the tokens Cognito issued, which the tab puts where the form's sign-in puts them, and the welcome.

welcome.description: Who the visitor entered as: the customer's synthetic name, from the curated list, and each card as list_cards returned it with the visitor's own token, in its order. No status, since a block changes it during the visit. cards is null when that read failed, and the welcome names the customer alone.

refused.description: No user was made: the day's guests reached their cap (full), or the chat is paused, which pauses the guest entry too (paused). The page says when a full day ends, in the visitor's own time; the pause names no time.
